    Infinite special right ladders #

    This file iterates the split-complement successor construction from Iyama, Tau-categories I, Section 3.2. Starting from an arbitrary special arrow, it produces the full dependent family of normalized special arrows and chosen right-mesh ladder rungs. The zero-padded summand of the initial normalization is retained explicitly for the radical-power argument in Lemma 6.4.1(1)(i).

    The construction is entirely categorical: it uses no presentation or classification of a concrete algebra or its modules.
